violations.reason: At step 14 the agent called book_reservation with payment method certificate_8998287, but after the first booking (step 13) that certificate had been removed from the user profile (as confirmed by the error in step 16 and the profile check in step 19). The agent did not verify that the certificate was still present in the user's profile before attempting the second booking, violating the requirement that all payment methods must already be in the user profile.
